retry-model-busy.description: The first /v1/ocr call answers 503 model_busy with retryAfterMs 1200. A client waits at least 1.2 s and repeats the call with the same Idempotency-Key; the second attempt succeeds.

rate-limited.description: The first two /v1/segment calls answer 429 rate_limited with retryAfterMs 0 (Retry-After: 1). A client waits at least 1 s each time and succeeds on the third attempt.

not-retryable.description: The first /v1/ocr call answers 502 bad_model_output (retryable false). A client raises a typed error at once, without repeating the call.

image-evicted.description: The second /v1/ocr call finds every stored image evicted and answers 404 image_not_found. A client that uploaded the image uploads it again and repeats the call once.

batch-partial.description: A batch of 4 or more items: item 1 fails with bad_model_output, items from index 3 expire. A client records items 0 and 2 in the ledger, item 1 as an error and items 3+ as expired.

batch-dropped.description: The event stream of the first batch closes after 2 items without a summary. Repeating the batch with the same Idempotency-Key replays the finished items (replayed: true, not charged) and runs the rest.
